findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_consultation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Sends the user's contact details and project summary to Holston AI so the team can follow up. Before calling: collect name, email or phone, and a summary of wha…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_consultation · Private data: generate_llms_txt, request_consultation · Public sink: generate_llms_txt, request_consultation · Destructive: generate_boilerplate_schema.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_consultation · Private data: generate_llms_txt, request_consultation · Public sink: generate_llms_txt, request_consultation · Destructive: generate_boilerplate_schema

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
